design_concept: OdysAI feels less like a sterile AI terminal and more like a beautifully curated travel journal. We merge the utility of a ChatGPT-style conversational interface with the sensory warmth of travel photography, earthy typography, and asymmetrical bento grids.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-heading font-medium tracking-tight text-[#292524]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-heading font-medium tracking-tight text-[#292524]

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow the content to breathe. Use asymmetric bento grids for form inputs and tight control room grids for itinerary data.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-[#E5E5E5] bg-[#EFECE5] h-screen flex flex-col p-6
layout_and_spacing.main_chat: flex-1 h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#F7F6F2] relative
layout_and_spacing.right_panel: w-full lg:w-[450px] border-l border-[#E5E5E5] bg-white h-screen overflow-y-auto hidden lg:flex flex-col p-8
layout_and_spacing.chat_container: max-w-3xl mx-auto w-full px-4 sm:px-8 py-8

components_strategy.login_signup: A beautifully centered card with no drop shadow. 1px border-stone-200. Background image split screen with the coastal landscape image on one side, and the minimal form on the other.
components_strategy.chat_input: Floating glassmorphism pill. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-stone-200 shadow-sm rounded-full px-6 py-4.
components_strategy.user_message: Rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm bg-[#C05621] text-white px-5 py-4 max-w-[85%]
components_strategy.ai_message: Transparent background, text on canvas. Small sage green compass avatar. px-5 py-4 max-w-[90%]
components_strategy.travel_preferences_form: Implemented as a Bento Grid. Destination is a full-width hero block. Dates, Budget, Walk Tolerance are square cells. Use native Shadcn Select, Calendar (not native date inputs), and Slider. No boring vertical forms.
components_strategy.day_by_day_itinerary: Control Room Grid style. Vertical timeline with a left border connecting events. Activity cards have flat backgrounds, no shadows, 1px earthy border, and subtle category badges.

micro_interactions.buttons: Hover state should lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and add shadow-sm. Use primary color (Terracotta) for 'Generate Itinerary' and 'Save'.
micro_interactions.cards: Hover states on saved itineraries should change background from transparent to black/5 (subtle darkening).

login_hero.description: Rugged coastal landscape for the login/signup background to evoke travel.

empty_state_texture.description: Minimalist topography texture for the chat background empty state.

ai_avatar.description: Elegant sage green compass avatar to represent the OdysAI bot.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width of 1.5 for a premium, lightweight feel.

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, itinerary cards) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute describing its role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Shadcn UI and customize heavily based on colors defined here.
Do NOT use generic blue or purple. The primary brand color is Terracotta (#C05621).
Use split-screen layout: Left Sidebar for history, Center area for Chat, Right Panel for the generated Itinerary (or render it beautifully in the chat flow).
Apply 'font-heading' (Cormorant Garamond) to all major titles to maintain the travel journal aesthetic.
Never use native <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn's Calendar and Popover.
Apply data-testid to every clickable item to prevent testing failures.
